subject: Follow-up: Security docs & next steps from today's discovery
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@harborworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Sep 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Security docs & next steps from today's discovery

Hi Jordan,

Appreciate the time on the call today — good conversation and helpful context about HarborWorks' ingestion volumes and compliance requirements.

Attached is the security packet I mentioned (Redwood_Security_Packet_2027-08.pdf) and a short extract from our SOC 2 Type II for quick reference.

Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- What I heard: HarborWorks needs identity-federation (SAML/SCIM), audit logs retention >= 12 months, and private deployment options for PII workloads.
- What we shared: SOC 2 Type II extract + product security packet (attached). Rishi is copied and can answer technical questions.
- Proposed next steps:
  1) Please confirm if SAML + SCIM is sufficient for your identity needs or if you need a managed IdP.
  2) Let us know whether compliance review will be led by Security (Sarah Kim) or Legal (legal@harborworks.com).
  3) If useful, we can schedule a 30-min technical Q&A with Rishi next week to walk through the packet.

If you don't have time to review the full packet, call out any blockers or a target decision date and we can tailor follow-ups.

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Security_Packet_2027-08.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: SOC2-Type2-Report-Extract.txt (txt)
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@harborworks.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@harborworks.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security docs & next steps from today's discovery

Logan —

Thanks for sending this over and for the recap. I forwarded the packet to our Security and Legal team. Sarah (copied) will lead the security review; Legal may have follow-up on the DPA.

A couple quick items from my side:
- Timeline: we aim to finish vendor reviews by the end of next week (Sep 10), but that could slip depending on volume.
- Retention: can you confirm that audit logs are available for export for 13 months on demand? Our policy requires 13 months.

I don't expect to need the full 30-min Q&A yet; we'll surface any technical blockers after internal review.

—Jordan
Head of Platform
HarborWorks
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@harborworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 08:58:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — any blockers on the security review?

Hi Jordan —

Just checking in on the security review you mentioned. Wanted to confirm two items you asked about:

- Audit logs retention: Yes — Redwood supports export/access to audit logs covering the last 13 months. We can provide an automated export job or grant your security team read-only access to the log archive; whichever you prefer.
- DPA/legal requests: If Legal needs our standard DPA executed, I can loop in our contracts lead (Monica) to accelerate.

If Sarah or Legal have questions, Rishi is available for a quick 20-min technical call later this week. Are any of these options helpful, or is the review still on track for Sep 10?

Thanks —

Logan
